item.title: Pathways for eco-industrial transformations in the process industries: In search of enhanced inter- and intra-organizational innovation models and production solutions
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on how process industries can achieve ecological transformation through innovative organizational approaches and production methods. The collection seeks research examining both collaborative mechanisms between organizations and internal innovation strategies that drive sustainability in sectors like chemicals, pharmaceuticals, food processing, and other resource-intensive manufacturing.

The special issue welcomes contributions exploring novel business models, technological innovations, and organizational practices that enable process industries to reduce environmental impact while maintaining economic viability. Research addressing how companies can develop and implement enhanced production solutions within this context is particularly encouraged.

Appel publié par Technovation. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Eco-industrial transformation in process industries
  • Inter-organizational innovation models
  • Intra-organizational innovation models
  • Sustainable production solutions
  • Industrial ecology and symbiosis
  • Process industry sustainability

Timeline

  • November 15, 2026: Submission deadline

item.title: Intelligent Knowledge Management Systems: Integrating Human and AI Cognition for Organizational Innovation
item.content:encoded:
Giovanni Schiuma, Università LUM

Péter Baranyi, Corvinus University

Francesco Santarsiero, Università della Basilicata

Dagmara Lewicka, AGH University of Science and Technology

The intersection of Knowledge Management (KM) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming how organizations create, share, and apply knowledge to pursue sustainability. In this context, 'intelligent knowledge' refers to the management of knowledge systems that dynamically combine human cognitive capacities with advanced AI-driven tools and models to facilitate ethical, inclusive, and purpose-driven innovation. This Special Issue examines how intelligent knowledge management systems can enhance organizations' innovation capacity and align their efforts with environmental, social, and governance (ESG) commitments and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

Appel publié par Knowledge Management Research & Practice. Lire l'appel complet sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • The design of intelligent knowledge systems integrating AI technologies and human cognitive capacities
  • Reimagining knowledge management (KM) practices to align with ESG commitments and sustainable development goals (SDGs)
  • Human-AI collaboration models to augment human expertise in knowledge work
  • The transformative impact of generative AI and large language models (LLMs) on knowledge processes
  • Integrating Human cognitive systems with AI-enabled technologies
  • Human-based emotional knowledge and AI-based rational knowledge
  • Challenges in Managing Tacit and Explicit Knowledge in AI-Enhanced Knowledge Management Environments
  • Development of transformative leadership competencies for navigating digital complexity and fostering sustainable innovation
  • Strategic knowledge intelligence approaches for building resilience, responsible innovation, and adaptive capabilities
  • Democratization of knowledge access and support for inclusive value co-creation through intelligent knowledge systems
  • Risks and challenges of automated knowledge production and ensuring the sustainability of AI-generated knowledge
  • Governance models and policy frameworks to guide the ethical evolution of intelligent knowledge systems

Timeline

  • January 15, 2026: Submissions open
  • June 1, 2026: Review process on a rolling basis
  • August 16, 2026: Manuscript submission deadline
